newsitem.title: INDIA: Hindu nationalists vow to block Miss World pageant.
newsitem.headline: Hindu nationalists vow to block Miss World pageant.

text.p: A member of India's Hindu nationalist Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) said on Thursday it would block next month's Miss World beauty pageant in this southern city, shedding blood if necessary.
"We will give away our lives, we will take lives, but we will not allow the show," parliamentary deputy Uma Bharati of the BJP, India's main opposition party, told a protest rally here.
Controversy has dogged the Miss World contest ever since Amitabh Bachchan Corporation Ltd, an entertainment firm launched by India's most popular film star, announced it would be held in India.
Activists of the Bangalore-based Mahila Jagran Samiti, or Forum to Awaken Women, have threatened to set themselves on fire at events scheduled for each of the 17 days leading up to the pageant.
"Over 100,000 people will lay siege to the venue of the Miss World and prevent it from being held," Ananth Kumar, a local BJP deputy, told a crowd estimated by police at 500-strong.
Other speakers vowed to chase the organisers into the neighbouring tourist resort state of Goa.

"We will not spare them even if the event is moved to Goa," said M.D. Nanjundawamy, the leader of the rural activist Farmers' Association, which has also attacked the Kentucky Fried Chicken and Pizza Hut restaurants in the city.

The rally organisers, the federation of opponents to the Miss World contest, said they were protesting against the commercialisation of women and the exploitation of womanhood by multinational companies.
The leader of the Forum to Awaken Women renewed its threat, despite authorities' plans to stiffen the pageant's 1,000-strong police security detail with a crack commando team.
"We will sneak in and self-immolate," forum leader Shashikala said on Thursday.
The contest organisers have announced a shift of venue of the swimwear section of the contest to the Seychelles.
